name: Mythos Realm
desc: A world of magic and myth where Greek and Norse legends intertwine. Mortals study the arcane arts, ascending through realms of power until they rival the gods themselves.

elemental.name: Elemental
elemental.desc: Master of fire, ice, and lightning. Raw power and devastating destruction.

skills.name: Fireball
skills.desc: Hurl a sphere of roaring flame at the enemy

skills.name: Chain Lightning
skills.desc: Lightning arcs between targets, devastating all

skills.name: Frost Armor
skills.desc: Sheath yourself in solid ice, absorbing blows

necromancy.name: Necromancy
necromancy.desc: Command the dead, curse the living. Death is merely a tool.

skills.name: Soul Drain
skills.desc: Drain the life essence from your foe, healing yourself

skills.name: Summon Wraith
skills.desc: Raise a spectral wraith to fight at your side

skills.name: Death Curse
skills.desc: A withering curse that rots flesh and bone

divination.name: Divination
divination.desc: Read the stars, weave fate, foresee the future. Knowledge is the greatest power.

skills.name: Starfall
skills.desc: Call down a rain of burning starlight upon your enemy

skills.name: Fate Shield
skills.desc: Weave the threads of fate into an impenetrable barrier

skills.name: Prophecy's Edge
skills.desc: Foresee the enemy's every move and strike their weakness

alchemy.name: Alchemy
alchemy.desc: Brew potions, carve runes, transmute matter. Versatility incarnate.

skills.name: Healing Draught
skills.desc: Brew a quick-acting potion to mend your wounds

skills.name: Rune Burst
skills.desc: Detonate a cluster of carved runes in a burst of energy

skills.name: Philosopher's Flame
skills.desc: The legendary fire that destroys and restores in equal measure

areas.name: Village
areas.desc: A quiet farming village on the edge of the Greek wilds. Travelers and aspiring mages often rest here before venturing into the unknown.

areas.name: Enchanted Forest
areas.desc: Ancient trees hum with arcane energy. Glowing plants and magical creatures dwell within the misty depths.

areas.name: Crystal Mine
areas.desc: A network of tunnels glittering with raw magical crystals, prized by alchemists and enchanters alike.

areas.name: River Styx
areas.desc: The dark waters of the Styx flow from the underworld itself. Legends say it grants invulnerability to those who bathe in it.

areas.name: Bazaar
areas.desc: A bustling marketplace where merchants from both Greek and Norse lands trade potions, materials, and artifacts.

areas.name: Labyrinth Entrance
areas.desc: The entrance to the legendary labyrinth of King Minos. A faint roar echoes from deep within the twisting corridors.

areas.name: Oracle's Cave
areas.desc: A sacred cave where the Oracle of Delphi once spoke prophecies. The air still shimmers with divine foresight.

areas.name: Arcane Academy
areas.desc: A grand halls of learning where masters of the arcane arts teach aspiring mages the secrets of magic.

areas.name: Mount Olympus
areas.desc: The sacred mountain of the gods. Its cloud-wreathed peak pulses with divine energy that empowers all who meditate upon it.

areas.name: Temple of Athena
areas.desc: A marble temple dedicated to the goddess of wisdom. Ancient wards still protect the knowledge hidden within its walls.

areas.name: Northern Shore
areas.desc: A rugged shoreline battered by cold northern waves. Strange treasures wash ashore with every tide.

areas.name: Mistwood
areas.desc: A perpetual mist clings to these ancient woods. The trees here whisper secrets of the old Norse gods to those who listen.

areas.name: Underworld Gate
areas.desc: A crumbling archway that serves as a passage into the realm of Hades. The air here smells of ash and sorrow.

areas.name: Rune Circle
areas.desc: A circle of ancient standing stones carved with Norse runes. They glow faintly when magical energy is near.

areas.name: Frost Peak
areas.desc: A towering peak of eternal ice. The howling winds carry echoes of the frost giants who once ruled these lands.

areas.name: World Tree
areas.desc: Yggdrasil, the World Tree that connects all nine realms. Its roots drink from the well of ultimate wisdom.

areas.name: Valhalla
areas.desc: The golden hall of the fallen warriors. Einherjar feast and fight here in eternal preparation for the end of days.

areas.name: Ragnarok's Edge
areas.desc: The very edge of the world, where the sky burns crimson and the prophesied end of all things draws near.

dungeons.name: Labyrinth of Minos
scenes: The labyrinth's stone walls twist and turn, swallowing all light. The scent of beast is strong.
Deeper in, hoofprints mark the dusty floor. A low growl echoes from somewhere close.
The Minotaur Lord stands in the center of his domain, axe raised and eyes blazing with fury.

dungeons.name: The Underworld
scenes: You descend into the Underworld. The air grows cold and heavy with sorrow.
The river Styx stretches before you, its dark waters whispering of the dead.
Shades drift through the ashen landscape, their hollow eyes following your every step.
A vast hall of black stone rises from the gloom. Torches burn with ghostly blue fire.
Hades' Warden blocks your path, his twin blades humming with death energy.

dungeons.name: Ragnarok's Edge
scenes: The sky burns crimson at the edge of the world. This is where Ragnarok begins.
Flaming meteors rain down as the earth splits apart beneath your feet.
A battlefield stretches to the horizon, where gods and giants clash in the distance.
The frost of Niflheim collides with the fire of Muspelheim, creating churning storms.
The bodies of fallen warriors litter the ground, their weapons still smoking.
A bridge of burning ice spans a chasm of pure chaos energy.
Surtr the Destroyer stands at the world's end, his flaming sword taller than a mountain.

Apprentice Sigil.desc: Sigil required to advance to Apprentice

Adept Crystal.desc: Crystal required to advance to Adept

Magus Staff.desc: Staff required to advance to Magus

Archon Crown.desc: Crown required to advance to Archon

Sage Stone.desc: Stone required to advance to Sage

Demigod Essence.desc: Essence required to advance to Demigod

Divine Nectar.desc: Nectar required to ascend to Divine

Herb.desc: A common magical herb used in basic potions

Mandrake Root.desc: A potent root that screams when uprooted

Crystal Shard.desc: Raw magical crystal, valued by enchanters

Pure Crystal.desc: A flawless crystal of concentrated magical energy

River Fish.desc: A fish caught from the River Styx, surprisingly edible

Pearl.desc: A luminous pearl from the northern shores

Sea Shell.desc: A shell imbued with faint sea magic

Spider Silk.desc: Silk from a giant cave spider, incredibly strong

Monster Core.desc: A core crystallized from a fallen monster's essence

Fire Essence.desc: A crystallized fragment of pure flame

Beast Relic.desc: A rare relic from an ancient divine beast

Mythic Scroll.desc: An ancient scroll containing forgotten magical knowledge

oracle.text: You meditate in the Oracle's cave, gaining insight from the lingering divine energy.
You find a pouch of spirit stones hidden beneath a loose stone in the cave.
A sudden cave-in catches you off guard, leaving you bruised and bleeding.
The Oracle's whispers echo in your mind, granting you deeper understanding of magic.
You spot a rare herb growing in the cave's damp corners and carefully harvest it.
A giant spider's web hangs in a side tunnel. You carefully collect strands of silk.

temple.text: Praying at Athena's temple fills you with wisdom. Your cultivation surges forward.
Athena's blessing sharpens your mind. Your comprehension has increased.
You find offerings of spirit stones left by previous pilgrims.
A hidden compartment behind the altar reveals an ancient mythic scroll.
You trigger an old ward protecting the inner sanctum, taking a blast of magical energy.

rune_circle.text: Crystal shards litter the ground around the ancient runes. You gather a handful.
The runic energy seeps into your body, advancing your cultivation significantly.
A fire essence crystal pulses at the circle's center, drawn forth by the runes.
Loose spirit stones are scattered among the standing stones.
The raw runic power surges through you, tempering your body to greater resilience.

world_tree.text: Sitting beneath the World Tree, you absorb its ancient power. Your cultivation soars.
The roots of Yggdrasil whisper cosmic truths. Your comprehension has increased.
Spirit stones cling to the World Tree's massive roots. You carefully pry them free.
Deep among the roots, you find the fossilized relic of a creature from the dawn of time.
The World Tree is silent today. Its branches sway in an otherworldly wind, but nothing comes.

valhalla.text: The warriors of Valhalla spar with you, sharpening your skills. Your cultivation surges dramatically.
A fallen hero left behind a mythic scroll tucked within their shield.
Spoils of war lie scattered across the golden hall. You claim a share of spirit stones.
Among the feast tables, you find a monster core taken from a slain frost beast.
A sparring match with an Einherjar goes too far. You are carried from the hall, battered.

sect.text: Study under the masters of the Arcane Academy
